scope: Additive filesystem-backed registered-execution admission and raw-oracle qualification successor for the exact 132-case dimension-valid Q043 matrix. It verifies exact checked-in deck bytes, clean-candidate source archive and executable bindings, immutable launch and reconciled execution records, authorized Orion paths, exact srun/MPI/decomposition evidence with one MeshBlock per rank, terminal success, every cycle-zero and cycle-one field/rank artifact, strict hardened frozen runtime metadata, raw bytes, and source-local oracle recomputation. It cannot launch, mutate policy, qualify Q043, Q023, or Q019, authorize a scientific claim, or authorize publication.

registered_case_contract.candidate_rule: Read and SHA-256 verify the clean-candidate manifest, source archive, executable, and environment profile as stable unaliased regular files under the authorized Orion root; require clean-source and build cross-links; open the source archive and byte-compare the full Q043 generator, oracle, admission, deck-manifest, and all matrix-deck closure against reviewed source.
registered_case_contract.deck_rule: Read the exact checked-in case deck and deck manifest from the reviewed source root, compare deck bytes to the deterministic renderer, require the manifest digest cross-link, and require an immutable launch-deck copy with identical bytes under the registered artifact root.
registered_case_contract.execution_rule: Require the exact authorized Orion run namespace, exact launch contract, immutable reconciled registered-execution receipt, exact srun command, exact MPI world/rank evidence, the exact dimension-valid decomposition with one MeshBlock per rank, unique scheduler identities, and COMPLETED 0:0 termination.
registered_case_contract.stdout_terminal_rule: Require unique registered rank evidence, cycle-one and nlim-one evidence, cycle-limit termination, zero exit and signal, and an exact cross-linked terminal receipt.
registered_case_contract.raw_inventory_rule: Require exactly one cycle-zero and one cycle-one artifact for every required field and MPI rank, canonical AthenaK output paths, stable unaliased regular files, byte counts, SHA-256 digests, and no path, inode, or execution-identity reuse.
registered_case_contract.runtime_metadata_rule: Validate cycle-zero and cycle-one sequential output bookkeeping and compare all remaining runtime parameters exactly against the repaired hardened frozen-runtime helper, including positive-integer PPC and effective species0 velocity agreement with the nominal CR stream, before recomputing the raw oracle.
registered_case_contract.raw_oracle_rule: Recompute the source-local raw oracle from admitted cycle-one bytes; require exact case and matrix result schemas, exact provenance agreement, and launch_authorized=false, scientific_claim_authorized=false, publication_authorized=false, passed=false; record that source-local or synthetic analyzer success is insufficient.
